lines.text: &fYour own private teleport points, and the ones friends have shared with you. Unlike warps, a home is not public and is never listed to anyone you did not invite.

&7Press &fCreate home&7, type a name and &fConfirm&7. It is created where you are standing, so stand where you want to arrive. How many you may keep depends on your rank &8- the button disappears once you are at your limit.

&7Names accept colour codes &8- &f&&a&7 for green, &f&&c&7 for red, &f&&l&7 for bold. Type &f&&&&&7 if you want a literal ampersand. You still reach the home by typing its plain name, so &f/home base&7 finds one called &a&&abase&7.
&7Click the &fpearl&7 on a row to teleport straight away, or pick the home and press &fTeleport&7. The search box filters the list by home name or owner.

&7Pick your home, open &fChoose a player…&7, pick a name and press &fInvite&7. Offline players can be invited too. They get to accept or decline; once they accept, the home shows up in their &fShared with you&7 list and they can travel to it.

&7One home may have &f3&7 invites waiting at a time. An invite nobody answers lapses after a day, and answered or lapsed invites free the slot again &8- players you have already shared with do not count.
&7Sharing lets someone &farrive&7. It does not give them the right to build there or take anything &8- protect the area with a plot if that matters.
&7Anyone you shared with can &fLeave&7 on their own.
&7Invites waiting on your answer sit at the top of the list with &fAccept&7 and &fDecline&7. Unanswered, they lapse after a day.
&7Old homes left behind by FTB Essentials are listed at the bottom. No command reaches them &8- press &fMigrate to RollMod&7 to keep one; it counts toward your limit.
&8Deleting a home removes it for everyone you shared it with, too.
